summary: Crisis probability crosses 36% as commodity crash deepens. Gold RSI 30, WTI RSI 26, Silver RSI 27. Equities diverge — SPY flat while commodities freefall. TLT +1.37% confirms flight to quality. Triple data Thursday (GDP + Durables + Claims). Core PCE + Russell Reconstitution Friday. Nikkei surges +4.07%.

risks.label: Crisis probability 35.9% — crossed critical threshold
risks.detail: Ensemble model: early_risk_off 38.8% (dominant), crisis 35.9% (up from 29.9%), neutral 19.3%, risk_on 6.1%. Expected drawdown 6.1% over 5 days. If VIX sustains above 20, regime officially flips to CRISIS.

risks.label: Commodity crash — gold RSI 30, WTI RSI 26, silver RSI 27
risks.detail: All three major commodity classes simultaneously oversold. Gold $4,009 (-3.2%), WTI $69.46 (-4.6%), Silver $57.55. Even traditional safe havens liquidated. Signals forced deleveraging or growth scare. Historically precedes equity corrections by 5-10 days.

risks.label: Core PCE Friday — Fed's preferred inflation gauge
risks.detail: May Core PCE drops Friday Jun 26. Hot print (>0.3% MoM) = 10Y past 4.60% + crisis acceleration. Cold print (<0.2%) = relief rally. Coincides with Russell Reconstitution = extreme gamma conditions.

risks.label: Equity-commodity divergence — warning signal
risks.detail: Equities held flat (SPY -0.05%) while commodities crashed (gold -3.2%, oil -4.6%). This divergence historically resolves with equities following commodities lower within 5-10 sessions. 72% hit rate since 2000.

risks.label: VIX touched 20.34 intraday — fear spike
risks.detail: VIX hit 20.34 before settling at 18.63. The intraday spike above 20 signals institutional hedging demand. A sustained close above 20 = volatility regime change.

risks.label: Iran-Hormuz standoff — Day 5
risks.detail: Standoff continues. Oil falling sharply (-4.6%) as market calls bluff, but physical blockade risk remains. Escalation = Brent $95-100+ immediately.

risks.label: China FXI at 52-week low ($32.33)
risks.detail: FXI touched 52W low, Hang Seng -1.37% to 23,090. Property sector unresolved, exports slowing, PBOC incremental approach insufficient. Commodity demand weakness partially driven by China fears.

risks.label: NVDA breaks below $200 support
risks.detail: NVDA closed at $199.00, breaking below the psychological $200 level for the first time since the rally. Next support at 200D EMA ($190.23). Semi weakness continues.

events.label: GDP Q1 Final + Durable Goods + Jobless Claims Thursday
events.detail: Triple data release June 25. GDP final revision — downward = recession fears. Durables = capex health. Claims = labor market pulse. All three weak = crisis confirmation.

events.label: Core PCE + Russell Reconstitution Friday Jun 26
events.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge + year's biggest index rebalance on same day. Hot PCE + rebalancing = extreme volatility. Position sizing must account for Friday gamma.

events.label: DRI (Darden) earnings Thursday BMO
events.detail: Darden Restaurants Q4 — consumer spending barometer. Weak = discretionary spending slowdown confirmed. Consensus EPS $3.64.

events.label: NKE (Nike) earnings Monday Jun 30 AMC
events.detail: Nike Q4 — global consumer sentiment bellwether. China recovery thesis test. Consensus EPS $0.12.

events.label: Nikkei surges +4.07% Thursday morning
events.detail: Nikkei 225 jumped to 71,988 (+2,813 points) in Thursday's Asian session. Biggest single-day gain in weeks. Semiconductor and export complex bouncing.

opportunities.detail: Near-perfect pullback to EMA20. 4/4 EPS beats, beta 0.354, div 2.6%. Entry $80.50, stop $78, TP1 $85.50. R/R 2.0. Perfect EMA stack, RSI 52.6.

opportunities.detail: Lowest fwd PE in mega-cap pharma. 4/4 EPS beats. Keytruda + Winrevair. Entry $120, stop $115, TP1 $130. R/R 2.0. Beta 0.218, div 2.8%.

opportunities.label: DUK — Utility yield play 3.4% (Score 83)
opportunities.detail: Flight-to-quality beneficiary (+1.18% Wednesday). 4/4 EPS beats. Entry $126.50, stop $122.50, TP1 $134.50. PE 17.7x. Bond proxy with AI data center demand.

opportunities.detail: 4 consecutive EPS beats, PEG 1.46. World's dominant advanced node foundry (60% market share). AI/datacenter demand driver. Entry $435, stop $410, TP1 $477.

opportunities.label: TLT — Flight-to-quality momentum (+1.37%)
opportunities.detail: 20Y+ treasuries rallied 1.37% on Wednesday as 10Y yield dropped 9.1bps to 4.40%. If growth data weak today, bonds could extend. Duration play for regime hedge.

regime_blips.label: Crisis probability crossed 35% — highest since Iran onset
regime_blips.detail: Crisis 35.9%, up from 29.9% yesterday. Expected SPY return -0.17% over 5 days, expected drawdown 6.1%. Regime transition forecast: ERO 29.7%, crisis 25.6%, neutral 26.1%.

regime_blips.label: Flight-to-quality confirmed — TLT +1.37%, 10Y -9bps
regime_blips.detail: Institutional money moving into duration. 10Y yield dropped to 4.40%. Utilities (+1.04%) and staples (+0.86%) outperforming. Classic late-cycle positioning.

regime_blips.label: Defensive sector leadership accelerating
regime_blips.detail: XLI +1.16% (near 52W high), XLU +1.04%, XLP +0.86%, XLV +0.77% while XLE -1.63%, XLK -0.62%. Rotation has momentum for second consecutive session.

regime_blips.label: Small caps near 52W high despite regime stress
regime_blips.detail: IWM touched $299.69 intraday (52W high $299.69). Russell 2000 at 2,986.63 (+0.37%). Domestic value names outperforming mega-cap growth. Broadening thesis intact.

regime_blips.label: DXY stable at 101.50 — no safe-haven dollar surge
regime_blips.detail: Dollar flat (-0.11%) despite commodity crash. RSI 76.8 overbought. Suggests this is growth scare / rebalancing flow, not classic USD squeeze.
